# MetaTF

> MetaTF is BrainChip's machine learning framework for creating, training and
> testing neural networks on the Akida neuromorphic processor. It includes a
> software simulator (no hardware needed) and comprises four pip packages —
> akida (runtime + simulator), quantizeml (quantization), cnn2snn (conversion)
> and akida-models (model zoo) — supporting TF-Keras and PyTorch/ONNX
> workflows on Python 3.10 to 3.12. Documentation: https://doc.brainchipinc.com

Models run on Akida as low-bitwidth integer networks: train in Keras or
PyTorch, quantize with quantizeml, convert with cnn2snn to a .fbz binary, then
execute on the simulator or on Akida silicon (AKD1000/AKD1500). Power and
energy per inference are measured on hardware; the simulator reports accuracy,
layer mapping and NP allocation.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/getting_started.html): first Akida model in under a minute — hand-wired XOR on Akida 2.0 layers, simulator only, no TensorFlow
- [See the power number](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/power_number.html): three commands from a pretrained model to measured power and energy (mW, mJ/frame) on an AKD1000, plus the no-device virtual mapping fallback
- [Installation](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/installation.html): supported OS/Python, pip installs, install verification checkpoint
- [Akida user guide](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/user_guide/akida.html): model/layer API, devices, hardware mapping, and the `akida run` CLI that reports inference power and energy on hardware
- [QuantizeML user guide](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/user_guide/quantizeml.html): quantize Keras and ONNX models to low-bitwidth integers, calibration workflow
- [CNN2SNN user guide](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/user_guide/cnn2snn.html): convert quantized models to Akida .fbz binaries, Akida version targeting
- [Akida models user guide](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/user_guide/akida_models.html): model zoo helpers, pretrained model loading, training CLIs
- [Engine user guide](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/user_guide/engine.html): C++ inference engine for deployment without Python
- [Akida 1.0 hardware](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/user_guide/hardware/1.0.html): first-generation IP capabilities and constraints
- [Akida 2.0 hardware](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/user_guide/hardware/2.0.html): second-generation IP capabilities and constraints
- [Akida Pico hardware](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/user_guide/hardware/pico.html): ultra-low-power Pico IP capabilities

## API reference

- [akida API](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/api_reference/akida_apis.html): Model, layers, Device, PowerMeter, mapping — generated from source
- [akida_models API](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/api_reference/akida_models_apis.html): model zoo instantiation and pretrained helpers
- [cnn2snn API](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/api_reference/cnn2snn_apis.html): convert(), version context managers
- [quantizeml API](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/api_reference/quantizeml_apis.html): quantize(), QuantizationParams, quantized layers
- [TENNs modules API](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/api_reference/tenns_modules_apis.html): temporal event-based neural network building blocks

## Examples

- [Global Akida workflow](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/general/plot_0_global_workflow.html): TF-Keras train → quantize → convert → run, end to end
- [PyTorch to Akida workflow](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/general/plot_1_global_pytorch_workflow.html): PyTorch → ONNX → quantize → convert → run, end to end
- [AkidaNet/ImageNet inference](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/general/plot_2_akidanet_imagenet.html): image classification, includes hardware mapping and power measurement on AKD1000
- [DS-CNN/KWS inference](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/general/plot_3_ds_cnn_kws.html): keyword spotting
- [Age estimation (regression)](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/general/plot_4_regression.html): regression on UTKFace
- [Transfer learning](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/general/plot_5_transfer_learning.html): AkidaNet transfer learning on PlantVillage
- [YOLO/PASCAL-VOC detection](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/general/plot_6_voc_yolo_detection.html): object detection
- [Segmentation](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/general/plot_7_segmentation.html): portrait segmentation
- [Advanced QuantizeML](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/quantization/plot_0_advanced_quantizeml.html): per-layer quantization control
- [Upgrading to Akida 2.0](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/quantization/plot_1_upgrading_to_2.0.html): migrate 1.0 models to 2.0
- [Off-the-shelf quantization](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/quantization/plot_2_off_the_shelf_quantization.html): quantize third-party models
- [Spatiotemporal gesture recognition](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/spatiotemporal/plot_0_introduction_to_spatiotemporal_models.html): TENN spatiotemporal introduction
- [Event-camera eye tracking](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/spatiotemporal/plot_1_eye_tracking_cvpr.html): lightweight spatiotemporal network (CVPR)
- [Vision edge learning](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/edge/plot_0_edge_learning_vision.html): on-chip incremental learning for vision
- [KWS edge learning](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/edge/plot_1_edge_learning_kws.html): on-chip learning for keyword spotting
- [Edge learning parameters](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/examples/edge/plot_2_edge_learning_parameters.html): tuning tips

## Optional

- [Model zoo performance](https://doc.brainchipinc.com/model_zoo_performance.html): accuracy of pretrained zoo models per Akida version
